variants.headline: Building project badly behind schedule
variants.body: The project {project} is badly behind schedule. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.

variants.body: The project {project} has fallen badly behind its schedule. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.
